import time,threading
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
import psycopg,pytest
from agent_guard.ledger import store
from agent_guard.authorization.exchange_service import TokenExchangeError
from agent_guard.authorization.consent import ConsentError
from tests.integration.test_exchange_service import _root,_form,_exchange
from tests.integration.test_login_consent import _setup,_session,_params
pytest_plugins=["tests.integration.conftest"]

def test_real_backend_death_rolls_back_exchange_proof(ledger,dsn,monkeypatch):
    a,k,r,s,root=_root(dsn); form=_form(a,root.access_token)
    old=store.record_proof
    def terminate(c,**kwargs):
        old(c,**kwargs)
        with psycopg.connect(dsn,autocommit=True) as admin:
            assert admin.execute('SELECT pg_terminate_backend(%s)',(c.info.backend_pid,)).fetchone()==(True,)
        c.execute('SELECT 1')
    monkeypatch.setattr(store,'record_proof',terminate)
    with pytest.raises(TokenExchangeError,match='TRUSTED_STATE_UNAVAILABLE'):
        _exchange(s,k,r,form)
    with psycopg.connect(dsn) as c:
        assert c.execute('SELECT count(*) FROM ag_proofs').fetchone()==(1,)
        assert c.execute('SELECT count(*) FROM ag_grants').fetchone()==(1,)
        assert c.execute('SELECT count(*) FROM ag_delegations').fetchone()==(0,)
        assert c.execute('SELECT count(*) FROM ag_exchange_evidence').fetchone()==(0,)

def test_real_sql_timeout_has_bounded_failclosed_effects(ledger,dsn):
    a,k,r,s,root=_root(dsn); form=_form(a,root.access_token)
    with psycopg.connect(dsn) as blocker:
        blocker.execute('SELECT * FROM ag_tasks FOR UPDATE')
        with ThreadPoolExecutor(1) as pool:
            start=time.monotonic(); future=pool.submit(_exchange,s,k,r,form)
            with pytest.raises(TokenExchangeError) as error: future.result(timeout=20)
            assert error.value.code=='TRUSTED_STATE_UNAVAILABLE'
            assert error.value.__cause__.sqlstate=='55P03'
            assert 9<=time.monotonic()-start<=18
    with psycopg.connect(dsn) as c:
        assert c.execute('SELECT count(*) FROM ag_proofs').fetchone()==(1,)
        assert c.execute('SELECT count(*) FROM ag_delegations').fetchone()==(0,)

@pytest.mark.parametrize('round',range(10))
def test_request_expiry_is_rechecked_after_actual_row_lock(ledger,dsn,round):
    s=_setup(dsn); session=_session(s)
    req=s.consent.create_request(session_token=session.session_token,csrf_token=session.csrf_token,params=_params())
    with psycopg.connect(dsn) as c:
        c.execute("UPDATE ag_authorization_requests SET expires_at=clock_timestamp()+interval '1 second'")
    captured=[]
    def connector(*args,**kwargs):
        c=psycopg.connect(*args,**kwargs); captured.append(c.info.backend_pid); return c
    s.consent._connector=connector
    with psycopg.connect(dsn) as blocker:
        blocker.execute('SELECT * FROM ag_authorization_requests FOR UPDATE')
        with ThreadPoolExecutor(1) as pool:
            future=pool.submit(s.consent.decide,session_token=session.session_token,csrf_token=session.csrf_token,request_id=req.request_id,decision='approve')
            end=time.monotonic()+5
            while time.monotonic()<end:
                with psycopg.connect(dsn) as c:
                    row=c.execute("SELECT wait_event_type FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE pid=ANY(%s)",(captured,)).fetchone() if captured else None
                if row==('Lock',): break
                time.sleep(.01)
            else: raise AssertionError('consent did not reach real row lock')
            with psycopg.connect(dsn) as c:
                while not c.execute('SELECT expires_at<clock_timestamp() FROM ag_authorization_requests').fetchone()[0]: time.sleep(.02)
            blocker.commit()
            with pytest.raises(ConsentError,match='REQUEST_EXPIRED'): future.result(10)
